FlexScriptClass.name: Particles.Direction
FlexScriptClass.Summary: An enumeration of the launch-direction modes, for directionField.

Property.name: Aimed
Property.Summary: Launch in a cone around the aim arrow (local +Z), with the half-angle set by coneHalfAngleDeg.

Property.name: Omni
Property.Summary: Launch uniformly in all directions (the aim arrow is hidden).
